analysis_md: $$\frac{\partial w}{\partial v}=\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}\cdot\frac{\partial x}{\partial v}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}\cdot\frac{\partial y}{\partial v}=ue^x\sin y+e^x\cos y$$
search_text: 设 $w=e^x\sin y$，$x=uv$，$y=u+v$，求 $w_v$。 $ue^x\sin y+e^x\cos y$ $ue^x\sin y+\cos y$ $ue^x\sin y-e^x\cos y$ $ue^x\cos y+e^x\sin y$ $$\frac{\partial w}{\partial v}=\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}\cdot\frac{\partial x}{\partial v}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}\cdot\frac{\partial y}{\partial v}=ue^x\sin y+e^x\cos y$$
